title: Leveraging Large-Scale Granular Single-Source Data for TV Advertising: An Identification Strategy
authors: Tsung-Yiou Hsieh; Rex Yuxing Du; Shijie Lu
eligible_reason: New instrumental variable for TV ad exposure with an IV + control-function probit on household-day data. No DiD.
design_notes: Step1-Step4 R scripts simulate exposures and purchases, run first-stage lm and second-stage probit glm with control function and bootstrap SEs.
data_files_note: README: only simulated data from a known DGP can be shared (NDA).
